deals.deal: Free Half Sandwich or Salad with $5+ Order
deals.desc: Enter code FREEHALFENTREE at checkout online or in the Panera app to get a free half sandwich or half salad (a $6-9 item) with any order of $5 or more - sign in with a free MyPanera account to apply the code.

deals.deal: $5.99 Strawberry Poppyseed Salad with Code SUMMER
deals.desc: Code SUMMER drops the full-size Strawberry Poppyseed Salad with grilled chicken - or the Chicken Bacon Rancher sandwich - to $5.99 on online and app orders, roughly half off the regular $12-13 price.

The Flavor Lineup tenders bundle packs 10 crispy tenders in up to four flavors like Lemon Pepper and Hickory Smoked BBQ plus a large fry and a large ranch - order online or in the app, feeds three to four people.

deals.deal: 3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.99
deals.desc: The all-day 3 For Me bundle includes a bottomless drink, chips and salsa or a house salad, and a full entree like the Big Crispy Chicken Sandwich starting at $10.99, with $14.99 and $16.99 tiers at participating locations.
August's margarita of the month is $6 all day at participating locations - a Lunazul Blanco tequila marg with a candy shark on top, no code needed.

deals.deal: $1 Sodas and $3 Crinkle Cut Fries In-App
deals.desc: Order through the Shake Shack app or shakeshack.com and any size soda is $1 and crinkle cut fries are $3 at participating locations - no code needed.
Subway's first standing value menu prices 6-inch Deli Faves subs at $3.99 and lists 15 entrees under $5 - no coupon, code, or app required at participating U.S. locations.

deals.deal: Free Refills on Brewed Coffee and Tea In-Cafe
deals.desc: Order any drink in a for-here mug or a clean personal cup and get free same-visit refills of hot or iced brewed coffee and hot or iced tea while you stay in the cafe - no account or purchase tier required.
Add a side salad for $1 with any online or app order of $15 or more through August 31 - an easy fresh add-on when you are already picking up dinner for the table.
